messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick sync — we need a concise set of launch gates for multi-region routing + tenant slicing. Can we agree on a minimum checklist we can show sales/customers?

ev an choi: +1. Sales want a clear statement: what 'isolation' actually guarantees at GA.

dirk thompson: Suggest 3 levels: soft isolation (routing affinity), hard isolation (dedicated pools), and air-gapped/private. Each has different cost/SLO tradeoffs.

priya rao: For GA, customers care most about predictable latency and data isolation. I'd push GA to cover soft + explicit SLA for cross-region failover.

joan li: From infra POV, soft isolation = tagged affinity + spillover policy. Hard isolation requires tenant VLANs + dedicated node pools. Ops cost explodes.

maria gonzalez: Proposal: GA covers soft isolation + documented fallback behavior + canary for one major customer. Post-GA v1: automated slice migration tools and dedicated pools as opt-in.

evan choi: Can we put numbers on latency SLOs? e.g., 95p token latency <120ms region-local, cross-region <200ms?

dirk thompson: Those are reasonable targets for small seq lengths. Need to call out degraded paths for KV-cache warmup and large context.

priya rao: Launch checklist draft: 1) policy primitives (region preference, tenant affinity, fallback order), 2) observability (per-tenant latency/cost), 3) rollback strategy, 4) canary plan + test customers.

joan li: Add: 5) throttling/quotas per slice, 6) documented cost impact for quantization/batching changes.

maria gonzalez: Ops risk matrix idea: list risk, trigger, mitigation, owner. Example: risk = region outage; trigger = >1% error spike; mitigation = automatic fallback to compatible variant; owner = dirk.

infra-bot: deploy-notice: Routing policy service v0.9 pushed to staging at 2026-03-21T16:12Z

dirk thompson: For policy primitives, we need a small declarative DSL. e.g.:
```
route: {
  preference: [us-east-1, eu-west-1],
  fallback: allow_cross_region,
  variant_policy: prefer_quantized
}
```
Keep it tiny for GA.

evan choi: We should also document customer-facing guarantees: what we DO NOT promise (no cross-region data residency guarantees in hosted GA). Important for sales clarity.

priya rao: Launch gating: must have 2 test customers in different regions, per-tenant observability, perf regression <5% vs baseline, and rollback tested in <15m.

maria gonzalez: Prioritization note: engineering effort split -> 50% routing core + policy DSL, 30% observability/alerts, 20% docs + sales templates. Is that realistic?

dirk thompson: Might be 40/40/20. Observability has a lot of hidden work (traces, tagging, ingestion).

joan li: Ops: need a playbook for tenant quarantine + evacuation. Will draft runbook and time-to-evacuate targets.

maria gonzalez: Action items: Dirk - proto DSL and failure-mode matrix (EOW). Joan - draft runbook + evacuation SLAs (EOW+3). Priya - customer-facing launch sheet + non-coverage list (EOW). Evan - latency SLO numbers and perf test plan (EOW).

evan choi: I'll run perf tests on small/medium sequences and add matrix for model variants.

priya rao: Also capture pricing implications per isolation level in the sheet — sales will ask.

maria gonzalez: Agreed. We'll reconvene next Tue after drafts. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
